title: Timed lyrics
description: Holds the timed words of a song in a lyrics file and gives them as text. The voice and music blocks read their words from it. It needs a lyrics file.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.doc: The language code of the words (a list of common ones; type another if you need it).

parameters.name: timing
parameters.doc: Timing granularity used by the lyrics file.

parameters.name: first5s
parameters.doc: Whether to check the first five seconds for the required opening.

parameters.name: file
parameters.label: Lyrics editor file
parameters.doc: The canonical timed words. Created for you in lyrics/<block name>.lyr when you first open the lyrics editor.
parameters.placeholder: choose a lyrics file of the project

needs: A lyrics file of the project (parameter file).
